plugins.name: codekit
plugins.description: Spec-driven development from ticket to pull request. sdd-plan pulls a Linear issue, branches, and hands it to SpecKit or OpenSpec; sdd-implement builds it; sdd-commit commits it; sdd-push opens the GitHub PR and links it back to Linear.

plugins.name: codekit-board
plugins.description: Product manager companion for a team's board in Linear, Jira, or GitHub. Answers questions about status and the product, and turns rough requests into story-sized tickets.
